# Robotics Tracker

> Robotics is where America's AI lead collides with China's manufacturing lead. Whoever combines intelligence with scale first sets the terms of the physical economy — and neither side has both yet. This site keeps the score.

Short form: **America has the AI. China has the scale. Robotics decides who gets both.**

A curated, continuously updated tracker of the US-China robotics race and the US
policy that shapes it. Every record cites a primary source. Maintained by one
curator, not an institution; the whole dataset and site source are public.

Site: https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/
Source: https://github.com/pranava0x0/roboticsleadership

## How to read this site

The pages render their data client-side with JavaScript. If you do not execute
JS, **read the JSON files below instead** — they are the same data the pages
draw from, and they are the canonical record. Each page is a chapter of one
argument:

- Companies = America's lead · US vs China = the scoreboard · Supply chain =
  China's lead · Themes = the leading indicators · Policy/States = the swing
  variable.

## Data (canonical — read these)

All paths are relative to https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/

Record counts below are **as of 2026-07-16** and grow as the trackers run —
treat them as a sense of scale, not a live figure. Each dataset's own
`last_updated` / `_meta.last_updated` is authoritative.

- [data/us_china.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/us_china.json): The scoreboard. A structured document, not an array: `bluf` (headline + body), `sections[]` each holding `metrics[]`, and a `unitree_case` study. Every metric has `{id, metric, us, china, edge, sources[]}` where `edge` is one of `us` / `china` / `even` — the head-to-head verdict on that metric. 35 metrics. Start here.
- [data/supply_chain.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/supply_chain.json): Where robots are actually built. Structured document: `overview.bluf`, `chain_stages[]` (each with `us_position`: strong / contested / weak), `categories[]` with US/China/RoW share percentages and `chokepoints[]`, `companies[]`, `stakeholders[]`, and `production_trend[]` (annual US/China/RoW unit output, with `projected` marking forecast years). 80 records.
- [data/companies.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/companies.json): Array of 81 robotics companies — `funding_rounds[]`, `deployments[]`, valuation, HQ, `map_category` (humanoid / brains / industrial / defense / field / service / enablers), `data_confidence` (high / medium / low), `sources[]`.
- [data/policies.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/policies.json): Array of 77 federal and state policy records — bills, executive orders, regulations, incentive programs, procurement. Each has `type`, `level`, `status`, `introduced_date`, `robotics_scope` (why it matters to robotics), and `sources[]`.
- [data/news.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/news.json): Array of 741 tracked news records, newest first. Each has `date`, `source`, `source_url`, `summary`, `category` (Funding / Deployment / Policy / Competitive / Supply Chain / Geopolitics / Research), `sentiment`, `confidence`, and often an `archive_url` (Wayback snapshot).
- [data/themes.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/themes.json): 8 cross-cutting narratives with `direction` (Accelerating / Stable / Slowing) — the leading indicators.
- [data/state_policy.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/state_policy.json): 5 state-policy themes — what states actually control.
- [data/agencies.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/agencies.json): 25 federal agencies referenced by policy records.
- [data/sources.json](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/data/sources.json): Scraper configuration — which feeds are ingested.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/): The thesis, the executive brief, headline KPIs, and recent activity.
- [US vs China](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/china.html): The scoreboard — every key metric side by side, with an explicit edge call per metric.
- [Supply Chain](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/supply-chain.html): Materials, components, compute, assembly — categories, chokepoints, capacity, and the stakeholder map.
- [Companies](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/companies.html): The market map — funding, deployments, valuations.
- [Policy](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/policies.html): Federal bills, regulations, incentives, procurement.
- [State Policy](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/states.html): Sidewalk/delivery robot laws, AV rules, incentives, the AI preemption fight.
- [Themes](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/themes.html): Cross-cutting narratives and cost trajectories.
- [News](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/news.html): The tracked feed, each item cited.
- [Robotics for Energy](https://pranava0x0.github.io/roboticsleadership/energy.html): Special report — robots across power generation, the grid, nuclear cleanup, and energy R&D.

## Citing this site

Cite the page or the specific record's own `sources[]` URL. Records carry
`last_updated`; the structured datasets carry `_meta.last_updated`. Data is
curated by hand from primary sources — quote the number, and link the page it
came from so a reader can check the citation.

## Caveats, stated plainly

- Record counts are small and hand-curated by one person. This is a tracker, not a census — absence of a record is not evidence of absence.
- `data_confidence` and `confidence` fields mark how well-sourced a record is. Respect them; do not present a `low` / `Medium` record as settled fact.
- Funding and valuation figures are reported values from press coverage unless a round is marked `confirmed`.
- News `category` and `sentiment` are assigned at scrape time and are occasionally wrong.
- Nothing here is investment advice.
